content:
alice_release: Heads up — deploy-bot just blocked the v1.14.0 promotion. CI failed during artifact upload, looks like a docker layer/cache issue. blocking release.

deploy-bot: Promotion for release v1.14.0 -> staging FAILED (pipeline 12345). Reason: artifact-upload-check FAILED. See job: https://ci.redwood.company/pipelines/12345

dave_ci: saw that. logs show: 
```
ERROR: failed to upload artifact: remote checksum mismatch
expected: sha256:abc123
actual:   sha256:deadbeef
Attempt 1/3 failed
Attempt 2/3 failed
Artifact upload aborted
```
probably a corrupted layer in the cache S3 bucket or a flaky registry push.

carol_sre: we should treat this as a cache corruption until proven otherwise. Don't do a blind retry during the change window (today 18:00-20:00). If we promote a bad artifact it could break tenants.

bob_dev: agreed. If the window blocks us, can we pin the release to the previous image (v1.13.2) for customers who need the patch? Or do a manual retag of the last-green commit and promote that.

alice_release: pinning seems safest for now. Tina, any objections from PM/eng release coordination side? @tina_pm

tina_pm: no objections. customers on the critical rollout can wait 2–3 hours. prefer pin+note in release notes rather than forcing a risky push.

deploy-bot: Note: automatic rollback not applicable (artifact didn't promote). Promotion state: blocked -> manual action required.

dave_ci: suggested remediation steps: 
- purge suspect cache prefix: `aws s3 rm s3://ci-cache/docker/layers/sha256/abc123 --recursive`
- re-run pipeline: `ci retry 12345` (will rebuild and re-upload)
- if upload still fails, retag previous good image: `docker tag registry/redwood/service:commit-7f4a registry/redwood/service:v1.14.0-candidate` then promote that image through our promote job.

carol_sre: also recommend running `ci artefact-verify` against the uploaded tarball to validate checksums before promotion.

bob_dev: quick check: do we have other pipelines using the same cache prefix? Might need to coordinate so we don't invalidate unrelated builds.

dave_ci: good call — some nightly jobs share the same prefix. I'll take ownership: I'll lock the prefix, purge, and re-run a downstream job in 20 minutes. If the retry succeeds we'll promote. If it fails, we proceed with pin+manual promote of last-green.

alice_release: decision summary: hold automated promotion, dave to purge cache and attempt a single coordinated retry in 20m. If retry passes -> proceed with staged rollout within change window. If retry fails -> manual retag of last-green and pin v1.14.0 to that image + update release notes with rationale and change window schedule.

carol_sre: I'll create a short incident ticket and add postmortem tag. Keep logs and S3 objects for at least 72h.

tina_pm: I'll update the release notes draft: add an entry "Promotion blocked due to CI artifact checksum mismatch; pinned to last-known-good artifact — follow-up investigation in progress." Will also notify support to hold any immediate customer-facing communication until we finalize.

alice_release: Thanks — looping in @dave_ci to follow through. please post final status here once done.

dave_ci: started purge now. will post back with pipeline result.

deploy-bot: Pipeline 12345: retry requested by dave_ci. Attempt 1 in progress...

dave_ci: retry FAILED — same checksum mismatch. moving to manual retag workflow now.

bob_dev: manual retag done: retagged commit-7f4a -> v1.14.0-pinned and triggered promote job 12346.

deploy-bot: Promotion for v1.14.0-pinned -> staging SUCCEEDED (pipeline 12346).

alice_release: final: release pinned to last-green image and promoted to staging. release notes updated, incident filed for cache corruption. We'll schedule a deeper investigation outside the change window. Thanks everyone.
